lines.english: "Nnn…"
"Huu～ haaah… nn…"
"Waaaake up～!"
"Iiuuu!?"
"How long are you going to stay asleep!? You're supposed to be overseeing the presentation for today's seminar, aren't you!?"
"W-Wait, n-no～! Don't use the vacuum～!"
"Then hurry and get up! Go shower, eat breakfast, and head to university!"
"N-No, don't do that… If you keep sucking it like that, it'll leave a kiss mark."
"T-Then hurry up and get up…"
"Nn, ah, no… Not there… a little lower… ahh… nnn."
"Haaah, haah, haah… eh? It's over already?"
"…Shouldn't you feel a little concerned about the perverted behavior you just exhibited?"
If I just let her be, she would probably do something horribly wrong with the vacuum cleaner… with an aroused expression as well…
"N-No, why did you stop halfway… My switch was turned on this early in the morning too."
"Hurry up, put on your clothes, take a shower, and then have breakfast."
"Wait, what kind of order of events is that?"
"Stop being so fussy!"
"When the sun comes up, you change back into a normal human being, huh? You vampire～ Even though you were sucking on various parts of this maiden's body last night."
"Vampires are only interested in the blood of a female virgin."
"You're the one who turned me into your servant～"
"That's enough dirty talk for now. Speaking of which, your attendance this year has been pretty bad…"
"It doesn't matter if I can't graduate. The path I'm taking doesn't require a university degree."
"You're saying that again…"
We've been living together for half a year now…
I'm still incapable of bringing about a change in her personality, as embarrassing as it is to admit it.

Her seminar attendance and research paper submissions only barely afford her a pass, too. All she does at home is sleep, and she leaves all the house chores to me. She's like a stray cat that's lost its wildness that would immediately huddle onto my chest and knees.
"I'll make sure you'll enjoy your life when I get famous someday, okay, Haruki?"
"I'm not bored to the point where I'll believe in dreams like that."
She barely worked for Watos recently as well. Instead, she went to apply to other major troupes.
"After you become famous, you'll just dump the man who raised you. Then it'll turn into some scandal in a magazine."
"What are you saying～ I can't live freely unless I'm being raised by you, you know that, don't you, Haruki?"
"Be more independent. You really feel a lot more like a parasite lately."
"That's why I said you only have to endure it for another three years. After that, Haruki, you may rely on me."
"I don't believe in dreams like that. I already have a job and I'm independent, I can live on my own no matter what happens…"
"Ah～ about that, try and work hard enough to feed the both of us for now."
"Why don't you stop chasing after that dream and find a path that's more realistic…"
"I made it to the final round of that last audition, you know? They're taking two people out of a hundred."
Her ability is what's worrying me. She easily manages to blow away my arguments based on common sense every single time.
"That's why… give me a reward."
"…I get it. Here."
"Nn…"
I move my lips over stubbornly, but even so, Chiaki happily accepts it.
"Hey, Haruki."
"What is it?"
And then, she buries her face into my chest.
"…Do you love me?"
"…As of now, yes."
…She presses both of her hands onto my own.
This kind of "promise" is something that I can never get away with.
"Even three years from now?"
"That'll have to depend on how you perform."
We've agreed on a limit of only doing it once per day. But if we both agree to it, then the limit can be ignored.
Even so, our "promise" still continues.
"Then, what about you…?"
"Me? Didn't I say it clearly last night? When you used both of your hands to rub my chest."
"…Hey."
"It's just like what I said, it's from the bottom of my heart, you know? Gosh～ that was so embarrassing～"
"You think I could remember what you said while I was entranced by the sensation in my hands? What did you say? Say it again!"
"Well then… do you want to repeat what we were doing～?"
"Y-You…"
But in the end, ever since "that day," I would always find myself completely succumbing to Chiaki's coup de grace.
After all, I can never actually win against her when she resorts to tactics like these…
"Hey, Haruki…"
"What is it!?"
"I'll make you happy. Someday, I'll make you say 'It's great being able to be with you,' okay?"
"Don't make empty promises like that…"
Moreover, she's only saying those words without actually acting on them…
"That's why you don't have to work too hard. You don't have to suffer on your own. You don't have to struggle on your own either."
"…Chiaki."
Because the cat that I decided to never abandon again confesses her feelings all of a sudden.
"It might take some time, but I'll be here for you, Haruki. …Until your wounds heal, that is."
She used to be a beast that was hungry for the taste of that wound, and she managed to reopen it numerous times…
"…It's fine, even if it doesn't heal."
"But…"
I pet Chiaki's head and let out a gentle smile as she looks at me with upturned eyes after she licked the wound on my chestーin my heart.
"I've already decided to live on with this wound for the rest of my life."
"Then… I'll hold onto the knife that gave you that wound forever, Haruki."
"Chiaki…"
But this cat is slowly turning into a human.
"For the sake of the three people who I admired. For the sake of never forgetting about the three people that fell apart. …And for the sake of never using this knife again."
"…You're chuckling over another good line you just thought of again, aren't you?"
"Should I show my face at Watos after all this time～? It seems like I got an interesting plot."
"I'll fix it someday. I'll definitely fix your twisted personality."
"Ahaha… good luck, Haruki."
"…! Hurry up, take your shower! I still have to clean the house, do the laundry, and cook… Agh, there's just so much to do!"
And in the end, we reenact our usual morning.
In other words, we're reenacting a spectacle that's typical of both our days and our nights.
No matter how mad I get at her and no matter how much I lecture her, Chiaki would laugh it off, give me some vague reply, and that would be the end of it.
And that's not all. She's simply incapable of ceasing to mess around like a clown all the time.
When I'm feeling down, when I'm feeling troubled, or when I'm feeling distressed…
She always saves me with her innocent, irresponsible smile.
That's exactly why I fall into unease whenever I remember the time I was trembling as I had my knees in my arms.
As a result, our relationship might return to the days when I received fake treatment from Chiaki.
But even so, I can't leave this trickster's side anymore.
That's why I will scold, lecture, and hold onto Chiaki…
I must "act" like I can't leave her alone and see to it that this sloppy girl continues to rely on me.
In order for her to remain by my side.
"Hey, Haruki."
"The truth is, I recovered a long time ago, my feelings toward you aren't twisted at all."
"But even so, I'll keep my act up. I never plan on changing myself, I'll keep making you sigh."
"So I can continue to remain by your side."
"I'll keep playing the role of the pierrot until you forget about the pain of that wound."
"That's why, Haruki…"
"Please keep lecturing me and let us stay together forever."
